'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Kurt Moss LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kurt Moss]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)|VB6-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
